about:
First Medical Inc. is based in Urbandale, Iowa, and was founded in 1985 by Ed Gogerty and Jim. The company began as a supplier of urological products and expanded over time to serve physician offices and broader healthcare settings across the Midwest.

The company operates as a distributor of medical and surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, and equipment. It maintains a stocked inventory that supports same-day delivery and 24-hour emergency service, with a pharmacist on staff to assist with product selection. First Medical serves thousands of medical offices and offers services such as par-level ordering, no-cost initial inventory programs, and stocking of items unique to a practice.

Its customer base spans the healthcare industry, including physician offices, clinics, and other medical facilities. The company is a member of Independent Medical Co-op Inc., which extends its purchasing reach and allows for a private-label program under the Quality Choice Physician Network.

First Medical emphasizes a service model built on flexibility and responsiveness: no minimum order requirements, less-than-case quantities, alternative sourcing during manufacturer backorders, and phones answered 24/7, including holidays. The company positions its Midwestern ownership as a source of economical benefits and goodwill for its customers.
